captures.plan:
# Note Octave 0.1.0-experimental: digiemu capture plan (OS 1.54, Core 2.1, Note Octave)
wait 3000
# audio track 1, TRIG page: FUNC + three detents left on NOTE = down an octave
tap TRIG
wait 500
press FUNC
wait 300
turn A -1 40
wait 150
turn A -1 40
wait 150
turn A -1 40
wait 400
release FUNC
wait 600
snap audio-note-down
# MIDI track 9, TRIG page: FUNC + three detents right on NOT1 = up an octave
press TRK
tap 9
release TRK
wait 500
tap TRIG
wait 500
press FUNC
wait 300
turn A 1 40
wait 150
turn A 1 40
wait 150
turn A 1 40
wait 400
release FUNC
wait 600
snap midi-not1-up
